checks: New save starts with two BR1.0 aircraft, 0 RP / 2000 GP; locked aircraft cannot be selected or used in campaign
RP spending caps at remaining research; ownership needs sufficient GP and purchase is charged once
Any one of four BR1.3 planes opens BR2.3; equal-weight alternatives are optional
BR stages cannot be skipped, including with full stored research; one BR8 jet is independent of the other jets
Wallet, partial progress and purchased aircraft survive reloading
Legacy v16 ownership, selected aircraft and bomber loadout are preserved; I16 remains researchable
Invalid saves cannot create negative balances, oversized research or locked selections
Campaign and airspace settle exact RP/GP rewards, including defeat and capped active time; repeated finish cannot duplicate rewards
Rewards count fixed simulation activity; pause and loading time do not add RP/GP
